business_delta: The A01 baseline is byte-identical. rcend9 changes only ProblemDescription and ResultCollection.SYSTEM.RCEND from 36 to 9; Control.SIMPE and Control.RCEND remain 36, and MISSION ResultCollection stays 0-36. simpe9 and simpe48 independently change only ProblemDescription and Control.SIMPE from 36 to 9 or 48, respectively; all RCEND values remain 36. Seed 1, the single mission, result interval 0.5, and behavior tables are unchanged.
pre_run_hypothesis: Native import/export retains all 13 populated source business tables. Baseline and rcend9 event logs should be byte-identical with native horizon 36, mission order 7, start 8, success/ready 10, and day-one marker 24. rcend9 should have only 18 half-hour System result bins ending at 9, while Stock remains 72 bins ending at 36 and full mission success remains visible. If simpe9 with explicit collection ends 36 is valid, model.log should have horizon 9 and show an active mission at the cutoff without the success/ready events at 10, while native result rows should stop or clip at the simulation cutoff. If the native converter rejects collection ends beyond SIMPE, keep simpe9 diagnostic and classify that combination explicitly. simpe48 should show native simulation horizon 48 in model.log, while System and Stock collection remains 72 bins ending at 36; its one mission at 8-10 should remain unchanged. ResultSummary range and terminal behavior must be observed rather than assumed.
acceptance_requires: pinned accepted A01 and manual/dictionary fingerprints
four fresh guarded serial session-0 SSH native runs preserving GUI PID 13340
exact business-row source roundtrip and zero converter errors for any accepted variant
event, System and Stock interval, summary, and terminal-state ledgers

diagnostic_rule: If a child does not roundtrip exactly, has conversion errors, or contradicts the isolated input-delta claim, keep its run diagnostic and do not publish that behavior as accepted.
limitations: One seed, one deterministic mission, no failure or inventory movement.
SYSTEM result RCEND only; MISSION direct time-dependent result output and in-transit/in-repair/reservation boundary states are unverified.
SIMPE changes only with all explicit RCEND values fixed at 36; earlier cutoff acceptance and incomplete-mission behavior depend on the separate simpe9 native observation.
GUI display and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
